description: The languages this product offers. Written by the new-project skill (or scaffold.ps1 -Languages); edit to add or remove a language, then run `npm run languages` in controls/. 'source' is the language strings are written in first; 'default' is the fallback for readers whose language is not offered. Sorted by nativeName, accents ignored. 'culture' drives plural rules and number formats; the Dataverse language id (LCID) of each RESX file comes from it (controls/scripts/dataverse-languages.json).

namespaces.description: Every string in the controls, including accessible names, as RESX files per control and language.
